description: Make the stock AGPTEK A02 flash driver (fwscf651.bin, from the official 20241019 update) unable to erase or program NAND: the only two functions that issue those commands return immediately. Contains no vendor code: offsets, expected original bytes, replacement bytes and hashes only.

patches.name: erase (NAND 60h/D0h issuer, FUN_00121fa0)
patches.asm: movs r0,#1 ; bx lr  (report success, touch nothing)

audit: docs/FLASH-INSTALL.md: every NAND command-register write in the driver was enumerated; only these two functions send erase/program opcodes. Read path (FUN_0012067e) never reaches them.
